Deep Research Loop Iteration for GPUPeek Apple Metal Research

Run the following commands in /Users/longxia/Projects/GPUPeek/src/metal:

1. Pick a research topic that hasn't been deeply explored yet (from: ANE, async copy details, specific algorithm optimizations, etc.)
2. Read relevant documentation and code
3. Write a new benchmark if needed to test the topic
4. Compile and run the benchmark
5. Update findings to the appropriate RESEARCH.md file
6. Commit and push changes with: git add -A && git commit -m "Deep research: [topic name]" && git push
7. Report what was researched

Choose topics from this pool that haven't been deeply studied:
- ANE (Apple Neural Engine) integration
- Core ML vs Metal performance
- Specific memory access patterns
- Algorithm optimizations (sorting, FFT, etc.)
- GPU family differences

Focus on creating NEW benchmarks or extending existing ones to get REAL measured data.

Deep ANE Research Loop Iteration

1. Pick a NEW research topic about ANE that hasn't been deeply explored yet. Consider:
   - ANE performance vs CPU/GPU for specific operations
   - CoreML model conversion and optimization for ANE
   - ANE memory patterns and latency
   - ANE vs GPU inference latency comparison
   - Batch processing efficiency on ANE
   - ANE power consumption characteristics
   - Different ANE-supported operations (convolutions, matrix multiplications, etc.)
   - Real-world model inference benchmarks on ANE

2. Create a new benchmark in /Users/longxia/Projects/GPUPeek/src/metal/Sources/MetalBenchmark/Benchmarks/Analysis/ANE/

3. Compile and run the benchmark to get REAL measured data

4. Update findings to RESEARCH.md and LOG.txt

5. Commit with: git add -A && git commit -m "Deep research: ANE [specific topic]" && git push

Focus on getting MEASURABLE DATA that distinguishes ANE from CPU/GPU performance.
